response.explanation: Protecting your family is an important priority, and it's thoughtful to look into this now. The options below are products to explore, not a ranked list or financial advice. Premiums, coverage amounts, and eligibility vary by person, so be sure to confirm material terms directly with each provider.

tools.name: ModernAdvisor
tools.why: This is an online robo-advisor that builds and manages diversified ETF portfolios and supports RRSP accounts. It may appeal to people who prefer a hands-off approach to retirement investing. Management fees and ETF costs apply.

tools.name: RBC Direct Investing
tools.why: This self-directed platform lets you hold RRSP accounts and trade ETFs, stocks, and GICs yourself. It may suit people who want more control over their retirement investments. Trading commissions and account costs apply.

tools.name: Oaken Financial
tools.why: Oaken offers registered GICs inside an RRSP, which hold money at a set rate for a chosen term. This may suit people who prefer lower-risk, predictable savings for retirement. Funds are locked for the GIC term, so check your timeline before committing.

response.explanation: Saving for retirement is an important goal, and there are several ways to approach it in Canada. The options below cover hands-off managed investing, self-directed investing, and low-risk registered GICs, so you can explore which style interests you. Please confirm fees, rates, eligibility, and other terms directly with each provider, as these can change.

tools.name: Hubert Financial High Interest Savings Account
tools.why: An online savings account that pays interest daily, with no monthly fee, no minimum balance, and unlimited transactions. It is offered to Canadians and is backed by a Manitoba credit union, so deposit protection works differently from CDIC.

tools.name: Motive Financial Savvy Savings Account
tools.why: A fully online savings account with no monthly fee and no minimum balance. Deposits are CDIC-insured through Canadian Western Bank, and transfers are made by direct deposit or Interac e-Transfer.

tools.name: RBC High Interest eSavings
tools.why: A no-fee online savings account from RBC that works alongside an RBC chequing account, with instant transfers between RBC accounts through its app and online banking.

tools.name: Oaken Financial
tools.why: An online provider of savings accounts and guaranteed investment certificates (GICs) with no monthly fees. GICs lock money away for a set term, and registered TFSA and RRSP options are available.
